_comment: Sentire Ledger tutorial videos, V01 to V57, in learning order (setup, records, opening balances, daily work, checks, period close, BIR returns, administration; B70, benchmarked on ECOUNT's Basic playlist, see the project doc claude/ledger-tutorials-proposal-2026-11-19.md). Seeded into PH Tutorial Video on install and migrate. Every video follows the five-beat script: topic, menu path on screen (menu_path), why, do it with the save on screen, and it ends on the report or document in ends_on. 60 to 90 seconds. The files live in the private video bucket under tutorials/<code>/ (video.mp4, captions.vtt, poster.jpg); upload them from the Tutorial Videos list. steps: the onboarding steps whose card plays the video. help_for: the forms that offer it under the Help button.
